description: A small white sheet of paper lies on the bed in front of both hands. The right hand slides in from the right to fold the paper over and smooth it flat while the left hand steadies it from the left, then both hands pinch along the edge to sharpen the crease; after that, the right hand lifts and opens the paper back up while the left hand holds it in place, and both hands press it flat again to emphasize the fold lines.
